page.layout: One page of text in the centre; a narrow strip of margin notes at the right edge (cropped, mostly illegible show-through of the facing page). Running head at the top above the text; page number at the top left of the running head. No footer text beyond the digitiser banner, which is left out.

main_text.p: étant Quæstiones, ut vocant, Proœ-miales, prolixæ illæ, centum ar-gumentationibus, earumque rur-sum refutationibus, centum plicis ac replicis exaggeratæ, quibus antequam datâ operâ Scientiam aliquam tractent, de ipsa illa Scien-tia diffusè tractant: Et ut uno velut exemplo complectar omnia, Logicam tradituri, quærunt, quid sit Logica, An sit pars Philosophiæ, an Instrumentum, An sit Ars, an Scientia, Quid Logica docens, quid utens, Quid naturalis, quid artificialis, Quod objectum ejus, quis finis, An ad alias Scientias adipiscendas sit necessaria, In quot partes ac tractatus dispesci debeat, & id genus alia quamplurima. page.notes: Right margin strip is cropped and largely illegible show-through from the facing page; only fragments such as "QUÆST." at the top are visible, and no reliable note text could be read. The lower-left faint marks are stains, not text.
